title: yadgar/project
$comment: Closure is per chart (ADR-0850): this schema closes only the keys this chart owns; it does not close any chart's keys but its own. Every value stays untyped (no `type`, `enum`, `default` or `required`) — a toggle's type, a boolean, and every cross-key rule are `templates/render-checks.yaml`'s job (ADR-0797, ADR-0847), not the schema's. This chart retains no typed leaf. Open maps, declared `{}` on purpose: `global` is the block the parent forwards to every module and the parent (not this chart) closes it; `resources` and `rollingUpdate` are bare Kubernetes maps whose optional sub-keys (e.g. `resources.requests.ephemeral-storage`) this chart never names, so an adopter is free to set any of them. Extras — keys a template reads that `values.yaml` does not declare, so declaring them here closes their parent block rather than leaving it open: `image.digest` is written by ci-release at package time (D65) and is absent from the committed `values.yaml`, which ships only `repository` and `tag`; `networkPolicy.scrapeFrom.namespace` is the one key an adopter sets under the `scrapeFrom: {}` this chart ships empty, to admit the metrics scrape (D54).
